parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS request
), scoped AS (
  SELECT
    i.request,
    p.id,
    p.local_operator_id,
    p.title,
    p.genre_main,
    p.intent_json,
    p.forbid_json,
    p.target_words,
    p.chapter_words,
    p.stage_code,
    p.run_status,
    p.current_l1a_id,
    NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.l1a_unit AS locked_l1a
      WHERE locked_l1a.book_id = p.id
        AND locked_l1a.is_locked
        AND locked_l1a.is_valid
        AND NOT locked_l1a.is_shadow
    ) AS design_editable
  FROM input AS i
  LEFT JOIN public.book_project AS p
    ON p.id = (i.request->>'book_id')::uuid
   AND p.local_operator_id = (i.request->>'local_operator_id')::uuid
), resolved AS (
  SELECT
    s.*,
    CASE WHEN s.request->>'action' = 'generate' THEN COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'node_code', binding.node_code,
        'model_config_id', binding.model_config_id,
        'model_config_version', binding.model_config_version,
        'prompt_config_id', binding.prompt_config_id,
        'prompt_version', binding.prompt_version,
        'template_type', binding.template_type,
        'temperature', binding.temperature,
        'prompt_text', binding.prompt_text,
        'prompt_status', binding.prompt_status,
        'model_name', binding.model_name,
        'provider_base_url', binding.provider_base_url,
        'api_key_ref', binding.api_key_ref,
        'routing_config_jsonb', binding.routing_config_jsonb,
        'parameters_jsonb', binding.parameters_jsonb
      )
      FROM public.v_prompt_runtime_binding AS binding
      WHERE binding.local_operator_id = s.local_operator_id
        AND binding.node_code = 'FP004-01'
        AND binding.prompt_status = 'active'
        AND NULLIF(btrim(binding.model_name), '') IS NOT NULL
        AND NULLIF(btrim(binding.provider_base_url), '') IS NOT NULL
        AND NULLIF(btrim(binding.prompt_text), '') IS NOT NULL
        AND NULLIF(btrim(binding.api_key_ref), '') IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY binding.model_config_version DESC, binding.prompt_version DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ), '{}'::jsonb) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END AS binding,
    CASE WHEN s.request->>'action' = 'generate' THEN public.rpc_get_effective_skills(jsonb_build_object(
      'local_operator_id', s.request->>'local_operator_id',
      'book_id', s.request->>'book_id',
      'read_mode', 'effective',
      'skill_category', '题材组合',
      'genre_main', s.genre_main
    )) ELSE jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'skills', '[]'::jsonb) END AS skills_response
  FROM scoped AS s
)
SELECT CASE
  WHEN r.id IS NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', false,
    'correlation_id', r.request->>'correlation_id',
    'redacted_error', jsonb_build_object('code', 'SCOPE_REJECTED', 'message', 'The selected book is unavailable.')
  )
  WHEN r.request->>'action' = 'read' THEN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'correlation_id', r.request->>'correlation_id',
    'result', jsonb_build_object(
      'book', jsonb_build_object(
        'id', r.id,
        'title', r.title,
        'genre_main', r.genre_main,
        'intent_json', COALESCE(r.intent_json, '{}'::jsonb),
        'forbid_json', COALESCE(r.forbid_json, '{}'::jsonb),
        'target_words', r.target_words,
        'chapter_words', r.chapter_words,
        'stage_code', r.stage_code,
        'run_status', r.run_status,
        'current_l1a_id', r.current_l1a_id,
        'design_editable', r.design_editable
      ),
      'l1as', COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'id', l.id,
          'l1a_index', l.l1a_index,
          'l1a_name', l.l1a_name,
          'conflict_background', l.conflict_background,
          'escalation_path', l.escalation_path,
          'stakes', l.stakes,
          'irreversible_consequence', l.irreversible_consequence,
          'plot_emotion_commit', l.plot_emotion_commit,
          'arc_requirement', l.arc_requirement,
          'info_reveal_boundary', l.info_reveal_boundary,
          'role_arc_json', l.role_arc_json,
          'status', l.status,
          'source_type', l.source_type,
          'confirmation_status', l.confirmation_status,
          'is_formal', l.is_formal,
          'is_locked', l.is_locked,
          'mid_goals', l.mid_goals,
          'world_progress_json', l.world_progress_json,
          'future_value_reserved', l.future_value_reserved,
          'future_setting_seeds', l.future_setting_seeds,
          'world_resistance_refs', l.world_resistance_refs,
          'jinzhan', l.jinzhan,
          'payoff', l.payoff,
          'emotion_type', l.emotion_type,
          'has_explicit_hook', l.has_explicit_hook,
          'consequences', l.consequences,
          'escalation', l.escalation,
          'related_hook', l.related_hook,
          'role_arcs', l.role_arcs,
          'participant_chars_json', l.participant_chars_json,
          'three_line_json', l.three_line_json,
          'return_direction', l.return_direction
        ) ORDER BY l.l1a_index, l.created_at)
        FROM public.l1a_unit AS l
        WHERE l.book_id = r.id
          AND l.is_valid
          AND NOT l.is_shadow
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'characters', COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'id', c.id,
          'char_name', c.char_name,
          'char_type', c.char_type,
          'gender', c.gender,
          'arc_json', c.arc_json,
          'is_active', c.is_active,
          'is_formal', c.is_formal
        ) ORDER BY c.char_name)
        FROM public.character AS c
        WHERE c.book_id = r.id
          AND c.is_valid
          AND NOT c.is_shadow
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'chapters', COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'id', ch.id,
          'l1a_unit_id', ch.l1a_unit_id,
          'chapter_index', ch.chapter_index,
          'title', ch.title,
          'status', ch.status,
          'run_status', ch.run_status,
          'is_finalized', ch.is_finalized,
          'confirmation_status', ch.confirmation_status,
          'word_count', ch.word_count,
          'formal_summary', ch.formal_summary,
          'updated_at', ch.updated_at
        ) ORDER BY ch.l1a_unit_id, ch.chapter_index)
        FROM public.chapter AS ch
        WHERE ch.book_id = r.id
          AND ch.is_valid
          AND NOT ch.is_shadow
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'sort_draft', CASE WHEN r.design_editable THEN (
        SELECT log.result->'result'
        FROM public.product_request_log AS log
        WHERE log.operation = 'fp004_02_sort_l1a'
          AND log.local_operator_id = r.local_operator_id
          AND log.book_id = r.id
          AND log.result->>'ok' = 'true'
          AND log.result->'result'->>'design_fingerprint' = public.v7_formal_design_fingerprint(r.id)
          AND log.result->'result'->>'candidate_fingerprint' = (
            SELECT encode(digest(convert_to(COALESCE(
              jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(candidate) - 'created_at' - 'updated_at' ORDER BY candidate.id),
              '[]'::jsonb
            )::text, 'UTF8'), 'sha256'), 'hex')
            FROM public.l1a_unit AS candidate
            WHERE candidate.book_id = r.id
              AND NOT candidate.is_formal
              AND candidate.is_valid
              AND NOT candidate.is_shadow
              AND NOT candidate.is_locked
          )
        ORDER BY log.created_at DESC
        LIMIT 1
      ) END
    )
  )
  ELSE jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'correlation_id', r.request->>'correlation_id',
    'context', jsonb_build_object(
      'design_editable', r.design_editable,
      'book', jsonb_build_object(
        'id', r.id,
        'title', r.title,
        'genre_main', r.genre_main,
        'intent_json', COALESCE(r.intent_json, '{}'::jsonb),
        'forbid_json', COALESCE(r.forbid_json, '{}'::jsonb),
        'target_words', r.target_words,
        'chapter_words', r.chapter_words
      ),
      'initial_l1as', COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'id', initial_l1a.id,
          'l1a_name', initial_l1a.l1a_name,
          'conflict_background', initial_l1a.conflict_background,
          'escalation_path', initial_l1a.escalation_path,
          'stakes', initial_l1a.stakes,
          'irreversible_consequence', initial_l1a.irreversible_consequence,
          'plot_emotion_commit', initial_l1a.plot_emotion_commit,
          'arc_requirement', initial_l1a.arc_requirement,
          'info_reveal_boundary', initial_l1a.info_reveal_boundary,
          'role_arc_json', initial_l1a.role_arc_json
        ) ORDER BY initial_l1a.l1a_index, initial_l1a.created_at)
        FROM public.l1a_unit AS initial_l1a
        WHERE initial_l1a.book_id = r.id
          AND initial_l1a.source_type = 'initial'
          AND initial_l1a.is_valid
          AND NOT initial_l1a.is_shadow
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'world_states', COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'id', world.id,
          'board_type', world.board_type,
          'atom_type', world.atom_type,
          'atom_key', world.atom_key,
          'atom_value_jsonb', world.atom_value_jsonb,
          'affordance_dims', world.affordance_dims,
          'setting_layer', world.setting_layer,
          'violate_cost_json', world.violate_cost_json,
          'chain_change_json', world.chain_change_json
        ) ORDER BY world.setting_layer, world.board_type, world.atom_key)
        FROM public.world_state AS world
        WHERE world.book_id = r.id
          AND world.is_active
          AND world.is_formal
          AND world.is_valid
          AND NOT world.is_shadow
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'characters', COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'id', character.id,
          'char_name', character.char_name,
          'char_type', character.char_type,
          'five_layers_json', character.five_layers_json,
          'knowledge_boundary_json', character.knowledge_boundary_json,
          'arc_json', character.arc_json
        ) ORDER BY character.char_name)
        FROM public.character AS character
        WHERE character.book_id = r.id
          AND character.is_active
          AND character.is_formal
          AND character.is_valid
          AND NOT character.is_shadow
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'open_bridges', COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'id', asset.id,
          'asset_name', asset.asset_name,
          'asset_description', asset.asset_description,
          'hook_category', asset.hook_category,
          'countdown_deadline', asset.countdown_deadline,
          'fulfillment_window', asset.fulfillment_window,
          'evidence_json', asset.evidence_json,
          'value_anchor', asset.value_anchor,
          'current_effect_json', asset.current_effect_json
        ) ORDER BY asset.created_at)
        FROM public.narrative_asset AS asset
        WHERE asset.book_id = r.id
          AND asset.asset_type = 'open_bridge'
          AND asset.is_formal
          AND asset.is_valid
          AND NOT asset.is_shadow
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'genre_skills', COALESCE(r.skills_response->'skills', '[]'::jsonb),
      'skills_response', r.skills_response,
      'binding', r.binding
    )
  )
END AS response
FROM resolved AS r;

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ (()=>{const content=$json.runtime_binding.prompt_text + '

FP004-01 V7 runtime contract: manually generate traversal L1A candidates only. This runtime DTO contract overrides any older illustrative output example above. Use only the scoped formal data below. Do not change the initial L1A, world facts, characters, or any confirmed/locked state.
Return only a bare JSON array. Every item must contain non-empty l1a_name, scene_location, conflict_background, escalation_path, stakes, irreversible_consequence; separate non-empty object values for plot_emotion_commit, arc_requirement, and info_reveal_boundary; a non-empty role_arc_entries array; a world_resistance_refs array; and a non-empty unique participant_char_refs array. Each role_arc_entries item must contain exactly char_ref, direction, and boolean conflict_with_L0. Each world_resistance_refs item must contain exactly world_ref. Use only the Cxxx and Wxxx references supplied below and copy each reference exactly. Never output, construct, shorten, combine, or alter a UUID or atom_key. Optional fields may only be is_patch, mid_goals, world_progress_json, narrative_techniques, future_value_reserved, future_setting_seeds, jinzhan, payoff, emotion_type, has_explicit_hook, consequences, escalation, related_hook, three_line_json, or l1a_index. Do not output Markdown, an envelope, l1a_candidates, commercial_check, role_arc_json, participant_chars_json, scenes_json, role_arcs, top-level L0_deltas, top-level conflict_with_L0, status, source_type, IDs for new L1A records, or any unlisted key.

Use target_words and chapter_words only to assess whole-book coverage; never lower completeness gates to hit a numeric target.

REFERENCE_CATALOG=' + JSON.stringify({ characters: $json.context.characters.map((item, index) => ({ char_ref: $json.reference_catalog.characters[index].ref, char_name: item.char_name, char_type: item.char_type, five_layers_json: item.five_layers_json, knowledge_boundary_json: item.knowledge_boundary_json, arc_json: item.arc_json })), worlds: $json.context.world_states.map((item, index) => ({ world_ref: $json.reference_catalog.worlds[index].ref, world_label: item.atom_key, board_type: item.board_type, atom_type: item.atom_type, atom_value_jsonb: item.atom_value_jsonb, affordance_dims: item.affordance_dims, setting_layer: item.setting_layer, violate_cost_json: item.violate_cost_json, chain_change_json: item.chain_change_json })) }) + '

INPUT=' + JSON.stringify({ book: $json.context.book, initial_l1as: $json.context.initial_l1as, open_bridges: $json.context.open_bridges, genre_skills: $json.context.genre_skills });return JSON.stringify({model:$json.runtime_binding.model_name,messages:[{role:'user',content}],temperature:$json.runtime_binding.temperature,stream:false});})() }}

={{ (()=>{const source=$('Require FP016 L1A Binding').first().json;const generated=$json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content ?? $json.output_text ?? $json.output?.[0]?.content?.[0]?.text ?? $json.output ?? $json.message?.content ?? $json.content ?? $json.text ?? '';const content=source.runtime_binding.prompt_text + '

FP004-01 V7 commercial and emotion validation pass: review the generated bare array for low-value duplicates, sustainable conflict, emotion variety, climax-budget overuse, and an explicit future_value_reserved promise. Return only one corrected bare JSON array using the same runtime DTO fields. Every candidate must keep separate non-empty plot_emotion_commit, arc_requirement, and info_reveal_boundary objects; non-empty role_arc_entries; non-empty unique participant_char_refs; and world_resistance_refs. Each role_arc_entries item must contain exactly char_ref, direction, and boolean conflict_with_L0. Each world_resistance_refs item must contain exactly world_ref. Every Cxxx/Wxxx value must exist exactly in REFERENCE_CATALOG. Do not guess or alter references, UUIDs, or atom keys. Do not invent facts, ids, statuses, or fields. If any candidate cannot satisfy the complete contract, return an empty array for the whole batch instead of returning a partial batch. Do not output an envelope, l1a_candidates, commercial_check, role_arc_json, participant_chars_json, scenes_json, role_arcs, top-level L0_deltas, top-level conflict_with_L0, or any unlisted key.

REFERENCE_CATALOG=' + JSON.stringify({ character_refs: source.reference_catalog.characters.map((item) => item.ref), world_refs: source.reference_catalog.worlds.map((item) => item.ref) }) + '

GENERATED=' + (typeof generated === 'string' ? generated : JSON.stringify(generated));return JSON.stringify({model:source.runtime_binding.model_name,messages:[{role:'user',content}],temperature:source.runtime_binding.temperature,stream:false});})() }}

parameters.jsCode:
const correlation_id = $('Require FP016 L1A Binding').first().json.request?.correlation_id ?? 'unavailable';
return [{ json: { ok: false, correlation_id, redacted_error: { code: 'GENERATION_FAILED', message: 'L1A candidates could not be generated.' } } }];
